I'm a pretty big fan of game music, and I generally think it's incredibly underrated. It's one of the most developed aspects of the young medium, in my opinion. I tend to be a bigger fan of the ambient stuff, so that'll be reflected in these tracks, but here are some of my favorites:

I'm a huge Jesper Kyd fan (Assassin's Creed 2, Borderlands). This one of his is probably one of my single favorite game songs, ever. It make the hairs on my neck stand up every time I hear it. Just an amazingly atmospheric tune. I can't believe they didn't include it in the Borderlands 2 OST, it took me months to find an upload of it after that game came out.

Also, a bit of a newer guy to the industry, but Michael McCann (Deus Ex: Human Revolution, XCOM: Enemy Unknown) has also done some incredible stuff recently. Here's an excellent ambient track from Human Revolution that I love.

Amon Tobin is a pretty celebrated electronic producer on his own, but what I consider the best game soundtrack ever is the one he did for Splinter Cell Chaos Theory. Seriously, it's absolutely insane. He did a song or two for the games that came after the series, but overall never scored a complete game again, which is an absolute shame. Phenomenal work.

Jack Wall did an insane job with the first two Mass Effects. Really did a lot to craft the feel of the first two games. One of my favorite songs is the one that plays in Ilos in the first game, which isn't on the OST for some reason.

I could gush about video game music all day. It's the best.
